transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm seeking help because I have an overwhelming, intense fear of animals, especially dogs and spiders, which I've been struggling with for about two years and one month now. It has gotten to the point where it is severely affecting my daily life, and I don't know what to do anymore.
Do you go out of your way to avoid dogs or spiders, even if it interferes with your normal activities?

Yes, I absolutely do. I will take long detours to avoid parks where dogs might be, or completely refuse to visit friends who have pets. This constant planning and avoiding has really disrupted my daily routine and social life.

inference_history.note: The patient reports an intense, persistent fear of animals—specifically dogs and spiders—that has been causing significant distress and impairment for over two years. This duration and the specific focus of fear strongly suggest Specific Phobia. Other anxiety disorders such as Generalized Anxiety Disorder or PTSD are less likely because there is no mention of generalized worry or trauma exposure. No symptoms of mood, psychotic, or eating disorders were reported. Therefore, Specific Phobia is the most appropriate candidate.
